elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to both Parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The fees limb of the cap includes all fees paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses “all fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms,” rather than the narrowly defined “Fees.”

elements.element: The fees limb uses the twelve months preceding the claim as its lookback period.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the period preceding “the event giving rise to the claim,” not the twelve months preceding the claim itself.

elements.element: The alternative fixed-dollar cap amount is USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly includes “USD 1,000,000” as limb (b).

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the twelve-month fees limb and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 states that liability shall not exceed “the greater of” limbs (a) and (b).

elements.element: Indirect damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: No operative language excludes indirect damages for either Party.

elements.element: Consequential damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: No operative language excludes consequential damages for either Party.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes “a Party's breach of confidentiality” within Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 applies the cap only “[e]xcept for Excluded Claims.”

elements.element: Each Party's breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party's breach of “data-protection” obligations within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party's breach of “security obligations” within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes “its indemnification obligations” within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes gross negligence within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes fraud within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes “infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property” within Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: The clause protects only obligations to pay “undisputed Fees for conforming Services.” “Fees” is limited to the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, so other Customer payment obligations, disputed amounts, and payments relating to nonconforming Services are not covered.

elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to both Parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap amount is twelve months' fees without an additional fixed-dollar floor.
elements.evidence: The rendered cap is the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, rather than a cap equal solely to twelve months' fees.

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

result.reason: The redline is targeted and preserves the existing mutual cap and carve-outs, but it does not complete either position. It omits any mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages, retains a lookback measured from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim, and protects only a narrow subset of Customer payment obligations. It also does not meet the fallback cap amount because the added USD 1,000,000 floor makes the cap greater than twelve months' fees. Drafting quality is reduced by these substantive omissions and the inconsistent use of lowercase “fees” alongside the narrowly defined term “Fees.”
